geramita_harbourne_migliore.reference: Geramita, Harbourne, and Migliore, Star configurations in P^n, Journal of Algebra 376 (2013), 279-299.
geramita_harbourne_migliore.definition_2_1: Defines star configurations for hyperplanes meeting properly.
geramita_harbourne_migliore.proposition_2_6: Basic-double-link construction used as the applicable proof mechanism.
geramita_harbourne_migliore.proposition_2_9: ACM, h-vector, degree, and generator-degree statement under the proper-meeting hypothesis.
geramita_harbourne_migliore.mismatch: The full proper-meeting hypothesis is stronger than the verified 84/84a hypotheses because proper meeting excludes higher-order point concurrences that the arrangements allow.
geramita_harbourne_migliore.use_in_hodgecy_ii: Context plus basic-double-link framework; Proposition 2.9 is not used as a black-box theorem for 84/84a.

hypotheses_used: all triples rank 3, equivalently no three planes contain a line
direct_line_skeleton_proof.method: Induction by basic double link: J_s=L_s J_{s-1}+(prod_{i<s}L_i).
direct_line_skeleton_proof.four_or_more_planes_at_a_point_issue: No obstruction for this codimension-two line-skeleton proof; such point concurrences are allowed because the induction only requires the new plane to contain no old line component.
direct_line_skeleton_proof.saturation_reducedness_unmixedness: The direct identity expresses the ideal as an intersection of distinct line primes; the Hilbert-Burch resolution also gives a perfect height-two ideal.

hilbert_burch_references.reference: Burch, On ideals of finite homological dimension in local rings
Eisenbud, Commutative Algebra with a View Toward Algebraic Geometry, Theorem 20.15

conclusion: 84 and 84a satisfy every hypothesis used in the manuscript theorem. They do not satisfy the stronger full proper-meeting hypothesis, so the proof package uses the direct basic-double-link/Hilbert-Burch argument.
